engine: EVER visual-search LEVEL 1 — pick a FLOOR on a static near-elevation building render, with the razor-clean floor highlight EVER has (and our smarts lacks). THE ANTI-CROOKED CORE: ONE , viewBox LOCKED to the render's intrinsic pixel size + preserveAspectRatio MATCHING the img fit, so SVG user-units == image pixels at EVERY screen size; each floor is a hand-traced PERSPECTIVE polygon — a corner-wrapping chevron of two quads (front face + side face sharing the near-corner edge) — so the highlight RIDES the building's perspective (slope + corner-bend) instead of floating flat. Hover -> terracotta fill (~45%) + a darker red TOP-EDGE stroke; ONE left-anchored tooltip card whose y TWEENS to the hovered floor's centroid-Y (never re-mounted). Per-building dim so the chosen tower pops. Harvested from D_ever_visualsearch_video.md (§2 / Level 1).

measured_teardown.move: HOVER/CLICK driven (no scroll). Floor hover ON: polygon fill 0 -> terracotta ~45% over ~120-180ms (fast, near-linear) + a darker-red top-edge stroke appears with it. Tooltip: ONE card, its y GSAP-tweens (~150-200ms ease-out) to the hovered band's anchor/centroid Y; text cross-fades; never re-mounted (re-mounting flickers). Click floor -> Level 2 (onSelect). Sold / 'not on sale' floors still highlight + show a card (cooler grey-blue fill) but no buy CTA. Nothing bounces.
measured_teardown.cited: EVER /visual-search/5: chosen building full-color, others dimmed; giant HOUSING N terracotta wordmark; Back-to-plan pill; hovering a floor lights a clean terracotta band that bends at the building corner (chevron) + a left tooltip ('20 FLOOR / Apartments not on sale', '24 FLOOR / 1 apartment from 23.2 mln') tracking the band's Y.

imgW.what: the render's intrinsic pixel WIDTH — sets the locked svg viewBox (the anti-crooked guarantee).

bands.what: [{floor,label,sub,status('live'|'sold'),points('x,y x,y ...' image-space 6-pt chevron),anchor{x,y}}]. GEOMETRY AS DATA — traced ONCE over the real render, never guessed.

fit.what: the img object-fit; the svg preserveAspectRatio matches it ('xMidYMid meet' for contain, 'slice' for cover).

onSelect.what: fn(floor, data) on click — drills to Level 2 (numbered-floorplate-select).

entry: CleanFloorHoverSelect.create(target, opts) -> { set(floor), select(floor), clear(), bands, destroy }. target = .cfh-stage > .cfh-render( img.cfh-img (or any render) + svg.cfh-floors ) + .cfh-card( .cfh-card__num + .cfh-card__lab + .cfh-card__sub ) + optional .cfh-dim. The engine LOCKS the svg viewBox to imgW/imgH, sets preserveAspectRatio to match `fit`, BUILDS one .cfh-band polygon per bands[] entry, wires hover/click, and y-tracks the one tooltip.
law: SVG fill/stroke + DOM opacity/transform + GSAP only; GPU; NO mix-blend; NO WebGL. THE ANTI-CROOKED GUARANTEE = svg viewBox locked to render px + preserveAspectRatio matching the img fit (NOT preserveAspectRatio='none' over object-fit:cover — that is exactly the smarts bug). Floors are PERSPECTIVE polygons in image-space (6-pt corner-wrapping chevron), adjacent floors SHARE vertices (zero gaps/overlap). Geometry lives in DATA, traced once over the render. reduced-motion / <=820px -> a floor button-list (render stays a visual). owns_pin false; hover/click, no scroll. Sets window.__LAB_OK__.
gate_mode: hover/click visual-search (not scroll). Verify: the svg viewBox is locked to the render px (not %); each floor band is a 6-point chevron that RIDES the perspective (top edge slopes, bends at the corner) — NOT an axis-aligned rect; adjacent bands share vertices; hover lights terracotta fill + dark top stroke; the ONE tooltip card y-tweens to the hovered floor + swaps text; sold floors highlight cooler with no CTA; click fires onSelect. NOTE: drive hover via real mouseenter on .cfh-band (api.set toggles the class but read after the transition); screenshot a mid-building floor to see the chevron bend.
proven: lab: a synthetic 2-point-perspective tower (inline SVG, built from the SAME geometry as the bands so they provably ride it) + 6 floor bands (28..23, 4 live + 2 sold) + HOUSING 5 wordmark + Back-to-plan + tooltip card. STRUCT verified: viewBox '0 0 1400 1000' (locked) + preserveAspectRatio 'xMidYMid meet'; 6 bands, each a 6-pt chevron, frontSloped=true (rides perspective, NOT axis-aligned), sharedVerts=true (band28 bottom == band27 top). HOVER (real mouseenter band26): is-hover class, fill-opacity 0.45 + stroke-opacity 0.9 (terracotta fill + dark top stroke). TOOLTIP y-track: card moves 232px between floor 26 and 23, text swaps (one card, not re-mounted). SOLD: floor 23 cooler grey-blue highlight + 'Apartments not on sale', no CTA. SELECT 27 fires onSelect. Zero console errors. Smoothness probe (4x CPU throttle, hover sweep across floors): 166 frames, 0.60% long frames -> PASS. Screenshots: mid-building floor 26 = terracotta band bending at the corner across both faces + tooltip; floor 23 = sold-state cooler band. Relative: isometric-building-unit-selector (axis-aligned <rect> hotspots, preserveAspectRatio='none', filter bar, cursor-following card) -> THIS is its anti-crooked sibling (per-floor perspective two-quad polygons + locked viewBox + y-tracking tooltip).
